documentation.title: Batch Processing
documentation.standard:
Do not load unbounded result sets ('numberposts' => -1, 'posts_per_page' => -1, 'nopaging' => true) in CLI code. Large sites run out of memory; process items in pages instead.
Requirement: F2 (MUST in the design model; warning here because detection is heuristic). Error codes: UnboundedQuery.
